compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Fourteen `tests/external/live_jira_dc` files contain 164 audited prose blocks with repetition, incident narration, or obvious setup. Scope and behavior were revalidated on `origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`; use the scope-correction comment that supersedes the prior 166-block ledger as the edit allowlist.

## Approach
Condense only allowlisted full-line comments and true leading docstrings. Preserve all executable strings, prompts, fixtures, decorators, subprocess arguments, assertions, directives, and Docker instructions.

For Python, compare immutable before/final blobs parsed with `type_comments=True`. Remove only allowlisted leading docstrings from modules, classes, functions, and async functions; normalize `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining ASTs to match. Tokenize comments by neighboring code anchors, reject changed inline comments or non-allowlisted hunks, and compare all `noqa`, `pragma`, type-checking, formatting, and security directives byte-for-byte. For the Dockerfile, remove only allowlisted ordinary full-line comments/blank lines, then require all remaining bytes and instructions to match.

## Scope
- `_bridge_output.py` — retain the canonical `BRIDGE_STATE: converged` route and the additional zero-write requirements.
- `_dc_fixtures.py` — retain captured Git output, bounded retry/failure, same-`FETCH_HEAD` census, two remote-free stores, inherited-environment snapshot, recursive bridge-state scrub, and proven local-ID/Jira-key binding.
- `_dc_support.py` — retain structural filtering, credential vocabulary, fail-closed reads, collision-proof rename, loud missing-extra behavior, exact oracles, raw REST/pagination, alert preconditions, and diagnostic-only parent probes. Distinguish compatibility `run_reconcile --mode --filter-local-ids` from primary `run_bridge preview|sync --only`.
- `conftest.py` — retain REST readiness, later Epic-field readiness, fail-closed project leaks, best-effort PAT reclaim, pinned-template provisioning, direct-endpoint teardown, positive absence after delete-404, fixture ownership/re-exports, and the `jira_dc_pat` “10” plus “SESSION” contract.
- `Dockerfile` — retain every instruction, runtime Maven download, `-DskipAllPrompts=true`, effective `-Dproduct.start.timeout=2700000`, default `600000`, both ineffective property names, and absence of parser directives.
- `test_dc_mutations.py` — retain every setup → mutation → independent oracle sequence, positive controls, exact assignee/provenance checks, indexed-read waits, relationship distinctions, degradation/alert evidence, deletion/identity proof, raw pagination, config equality, and cleanup.
- `test_dc_rich_text_live.py` — retain raw-wire/rendered-HTML boundaries, primary `--only` scoping, direct reads, cutover environment, second-pass zero writes, and local-wins conflict recording; remove stale `--filter-local-ids` claims.
- `test_dc_richtext_agentic_probe.py` — retain investigation-only semantics and structured results; keep `_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, tool docstrings, and every instruction string byte-exact.
- `test_harness_smoke.py` — retain raw REST, Server/DC deployment/version checks, PAT authentication contrast, and cleanup.
- `test_multi_project_rehearsal.py` — retain intended-project-only preview, index waits, legacy default, isolated store copy, preview-before-write, unknown-project continuation, promote-only binding, capability failure, and direct-read cleanup.
- `test_reconcile_pass.py` — retain exact DC config, env-only PAT, canonical completion signal, counter-based idempotence, provenance/binding, and exact derived-ID matching.
- `test_store_copy_isolation.py` — retain no-remote checks, inherited-job evidence, complete-copy/scrub proof, plan/apply separation, local-ID-plus-key scope, no deletion/update plan, and remote readback.
- `test_transport.py` — retain identity resolution, resolver/apply responsibility split, method coverage, stable numeric ID across re-key, permission controls, and measured label ceiling.
- `test_user_guide_commands.py` — retain guide parsing, documented substitutions, real preview envelope/nonmutation, and the missing-`JIRA_PAT` error.

Consumers are real: helpers are imported by live and offline tests; fixtures are discovered/re-exported by pytest; test modules run through workflow globs; the Dockerfile is built by compose, Make, workflows, and shape tests; source guards read mutation/store-copy/transport files.

Keep these inline directives exactly attached: `_dc_fixtures.py:101 pragma`; `_dc_support.py:146 noqa`; `conftest.py:51,65,81 noqa`; `test_dc_mutations.py:306,889 pragma`; `test_dc_richtext_agentic_probe.py:222 noqa`; `test_multi_project_rehearsal.py:743,751 noqa`; `test_reconcile_pass.py:68 noqa`; `test_transport.py:66,284,779 noqa`; `test_user_guide_commands.py:53 noqa`. Line numbers identify the pinned blob; the guard uses code anchors.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Changes are limited to the 164 stable-ID allowlisted prose blocks, true docstrings, and adjacent blank lines; Python normalized-AST/comment/directive checks and Docker byte comparison pass.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and preserves its listed contract/consumer without relocating history, repetition, or ornament.
- [ ] A reviewer who did not author the edits posts a leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block: stable block ID, immutable before/final citations, preserved contract/consumer, directives-exact, before/after words, semantic-preservation, bloat-removal, and reviewer session.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing/failing rows or citations block closure.
- [ ] Focused offline checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify` pass; no live Jira suite is required.

## Verification
Run the recorded content-only comparator; scoped Ruff check/format; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; the offline unit/node set in the audit comment; path-scoped `git diff --check`; and `make verify`. The independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality.
